LESSON: SEASONS IN THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Seasons in the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Seasons in the County, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do seasons influence human activities in the county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the four seasons experienced in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Seasons in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain how the four seasons influence human activities in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Seasons in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. explore how rainy weather affects road safety in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Seasons in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. model weather charts of seasons in the county,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Seasons in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate the different seasons experienced in the county.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Seasons in the County in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Collaboration: Learners develop relationships as they brainstorm about seasons experienced in the county.

● Digital Literacy: Learners use print or digital resources to identify seasons experienced in the county.

Values:
● Respect: Learners appreciate diverse opinions as they brainstorm about seasons experienced in the county.

● Patriotism: Learners sing songs about seasons experienced in the county,

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and security: Learners discuss precautions to take during the different seasons experienced in the county (Hot, cold,

dry and rainy season).
